rca of the issue: Reproduction: navigate world -> token dashboard (search or building click) and observe console; Recharts sometimes logs width/height -1. Likely chart mounts before stable container size after layout transition. Mitigation: ensure chart parent has deterministic dimensions before render (guarded render or ResizeObserver-triggered mount).
